interest: Shows Japanese expatriate groups in Italy surveilling residents under Embassy direction, and Allied sharing on a dual Axis consular official.
overview: Covers Japanese activity in wartime Italy: the 1943 arrest of Naples's dual Japanese-German Honorary Consul, and a 1944 ONI translation on the Roma Nippon Kurabu's resident surveillance.

people.name: Frederick B. Lyon
people.role: Department of State official (Division of Foreign Activity Correlation)

people.name: Wallace S. Wharton
people.role: Captain, U.S.N.R., Office of the Chief of Naval Operations

subfiles.about: Cross-reference sheet noting the arrest in Naples of an honorary Japanese consul who was also a German consular employee, and requesting internment instructions.
subfiles.summary: Cross-reference (Nov 1943): the Japanese Honorary Consul in Naples, also a minor German consular employee, was arrested and interned.
subfiles.title: Cross-Reference Sheet on Arrest and Internment of Japanese Honorary Consul in Naples

subfiles.about: Cover memorandum transmitting an Office of Naval Intelligence translation concerning the activities of the Roma Nippon Kurabu.
subfiles.from: Wallace S. Wharton, Captain, U.S.N.R. (Office of the Chief of Naval Operations)
keywords: Office of the Chief of Naval Operations
subfiles.summary: Capt. Wharton forwards a 1944 ONI translation on the Roma Nippon Kurabu to the State Department, also noting FBI awareness.
subfiles.title: Memorandum from Captain Wallace S. Wharton to Frederick B. Lyon regarding Roma Nippon Kurabu

subfiles.about: Office of Naval Intelligence translation of a captured 1943 letter from the Nippon Club in Rome submitting civilian surveillance and passport check reports to the Japanese Embassy.
subfiles.from: Office of Naval Intelligence / Commander Eighth Fleet, Naval Intelligence Unit
subfiles.summary: ONI translation of a 1943 Roma Nippon Kurabu letter on a passport check of Japanese residents, tied closely to Embassy.
subfiles.title: Office of Naval Intelligence Translation: Roma Nippon Kurabu Activities and Passport Check
